short_description: Talkspace for Business offers employee mental health benefits with text, video, and audio therapy sessions.
long_description: Talkspace for Business is the enterprise offering from Talkspace, providing employee mental health benefits to organizations of all sizes. The platform offers flexible therapy formats including asynchronous text messaging, live video sessions, and audio messaging, making it accessible for employees with varying schedules. Talkspace for Business starts at approximately $500/month for small businesses and scales up for larger enterprises. The platform features a network of licensed therapists and psychiatrists, with particular emphasis on diversity and representation including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ experienced providers. Employers receive aggregate utilization reporting without individual PHI.
